preconditions.description: The dimensions n, m, and k must be within the range of 1 to 100.

preconditions.expression: all(len(block) == m for block in layers) and all(len(line) == k for line in block for block in layers)
preconditions.description: Each layer must have m lines, and each line must have k characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for block in layers for line in block for c in line)
preconditions.description: Each character in the input must be either '0' or '1'.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of critical CPUs as a string.
